value.name: woman closes and replaces object carefully
value.description: She closes the object with both hands and sets it back exactly where it had been, carefully aligning it with the shadow it left on the wood.
evidence: She closed it with both hands and set it back exactly where it had been, lining the worn corner up with the faint shadow it had left on the wood

value.name: woman turns to confront Claire
value.description: After replacing the object, she turns to face Claire across the kitchen.
evidence: and only then did she turn to face Claire across the kitchen

value.name: woman asks how long Claire has known
value.description: She asks Claire how long she has known, speaking in a low voice so the children upstairs will not hear.
evidence: "How long have you known," she said, not as a question, the words pitched low enough that the children upstairs would not have heard them through a closed door

value.name: Claire silently confirms knowledge
value.description: Claire's stillness at the chair edge reveals that she already knows the answer before speaking.
evidence: and Claire's hand on the chair edge went still in a way that answered before her mouth did
